decisions.reason: The firm has made a visible and successful public commitment to A through named government use and broad scheme connectivity, so under escalation of commitment management is very unlikely to withdraw it.

B remained prominently marketed on its own page into 2024 and fits the firm's travel-security offering, so management would likely continue backing it and attribute any weak traction to slow regulatory and client adoption rather than failure.

F also stayed on a dedicated page in 2024 and appears complementary to the firm's border and verification solutions, which makes management inclined to retain it after already investing and signaling commitment to the market.
